review_type: Coordinating semantic inventory; independent review challenged first draft. Not independently confirmed complete coverage.
mechanical_domain: Finite residual decisions only. Option labels denote strategies; they do not enumerate all concrete traces. Positive analysis depends on reviewed fixed obligations below.

D-stable-freedom: direction may be chosen per call; no direction consistency promise
D-unconstrained: consumer must ignore order including across calls

exclusions: duplicate identities excluded by declared input domain
creation ties excluded by unique sequence numbers

mutation_semantic_assessment.ordering: Removed ordering leaves membership/frame but no sequence policy.
mutation_semantic_assessment.defaulting: Removed default rule leaves present-field equality; absent-field comparison remains disputed, not independently validated.
mutation_semantic_assessment.tie-breaking: Removed tie rule leaves one maximizer; this may be interpreted as implicit delegation. Detection is model-local, semantic necessity remains disputed.
mutation_semantic_assessment.rejection: Removed error branch leaves negative-input behavior without authority in the all-integer domain.
mutation_semantic_assessment.transition: Removed entire accepted/rejected condition leaves no transition or return specification.
mutation_semantic_assessment.cardinality: Removed all-ties clause leaves a list drawn from maxima without specified cardinality. Ordinary refinement interpretations may allow arbitrary subsets; authority policy requires determination/delegation.
mutation_semantic_assessment.normalization: Removed endpoint-space rule leaves lowercasing. Reviewer notes ordinary case-conversion semantics may already preserve spaces; semantic underspecification remains disputed.
mutation_semantic_assessment.internal: Removed algorithm sentence cannot alter required sum/no-effect observations.

authority_policy: Material silence is blocked prospectively; this is an explicit authoring discipline, not a universal theorem about refinement semantics. Necessary implications can determine choices, but need reviewed entailment evidence.
